name: stream-input-refused-unreachable

graded_by.test: core/internal/session/unreachable_test.go — input to an unreachable session is not forwarded and is answered input_refused unreachable
harness/rigs/unreachable.sh — a client attached to a session on a frozen v0.1 worker types, and receives input_refused unreachable

description: Input to an unreachable session is rejected with an explicit error (decision 5.38; immortality §3): the core forwards nothing and answers input_refused with reason unreachable, so no keystroke vanishes without a signal.
